interface.step: step(body61, previous_raw14=actual_last_sent_raw14, phase_s=public_elapsed_or_minus1, ready=bool, authorized=bool, head_return_complete=bool)

caller_responsibilities: Same-read finite BODY50 public61 input only; validate current50Hz sample/read/delivery timestamps every control tick.
Public sensor supervisor owns target admission, successful physical head-neutral return, clock start, terminal and abort behavior.
Record authorization inputs; no simulator truth enters supervisor or adapter.
Supply actual sent history unchanged at body61[34:48] and previous_raw14; do not substitute predicted or pre-filtered history.
Original home+raw-bias native BAM scale1, no clipping/EMA/target projection.
At4seconds finish and score actual trajectory. Do not indefinitely call phase4 or silently reset.
ready=false returns native rawzero without network inference; physical safety/abort handling remains supervisor-owned.
